# 2 Baruch Chapter 23 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Second Fast and Dialogue

---

**23:1** And-I-answered and-said: O LORD my-Lord, I-said before-you already [what] I-knew, and-I-learned what-I-did-not-know.

**23:2** For you-have-said previously that-you-know the-number-of-those-who-are-born — how-many there-shall-be, how-many-have-already-come, and-how-many are-yet-to-come —

**23:3** But-this [one thing] I-say before-you: just-as-those-who-are-in the-womb do-not-know the-hour-of-their-coming-forth, and-those-who-return [to-the-dust] do-not-know the-hour of-their-departure —

**23:4** So-also human-beings do-not-know [the-hour] of-your-visitation.

**23:5** And-I-said to-him: But-are-there-indeed souls which-are-set-aside in-the-treasury, so-that-when-the-number-is-fulfilled they-may-come-forth?

**23:6** And-he-answered and-said to-me: All-the-souls which-are-now [alive], and-those-which-have-already-departed, and-those-which-are-yet-to-come-into-being — behold, [they-are-all] with-him.

**23:7** For-the-Most-High has-not-made the-world except-for-the-sake-of-many, but-the-coming-[one] will-not-come until-the-number-which-has-been-decreed is-complete.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac Codex Ambrosianus. Chapter 23 introduces the key concept of the heavenly "treasury of souls" — a fixed number that must be filled before the end can come. The womb-analogy in vv.3-4 is striking.*
